purpose: EWH-1.1 private Windows WinUI host binding template; not an executable runner or readiness receipt
privateConfiguration: Keep the populated copy outside source Git; never include passwords or private keys.

toolchain.pinningRule: Set exact installed versions from the selected native consumer manifests before compilation. Null fields are unresolved prerequisites, never wildcards or latest-version selectors. Record whether .NET is required by that consumer.

consumer.commandPolicy: Populate only reviewed bootstrap/build commands with explicit native exit handling. No arbitrary remote command dispatcher.

receiptRequired: actual OS build and activation state
exact SDK/MSVC/MSBuild/Windows App SDK/WinUI and applicable .NET versions
interactive WinUI control bootstrap executed/passed/failed/skipped counts, with nonzero cases and no unresolved failures or required skips
resume: Finish Windows first-run/account setup manually, provision the existing QA harness, and establish SSH plus unlocked desktop readiness before installing the selected WinUI toolchain. See architecture/operations/local-native-testing.md.
